nodes.title: Grade
widgets_values:
A basic grade in order: White Balance, then Grade (lift, gamma, gain, offset, contrast, saturation, or a preset), then an ASC CDL (slope, offset, power, saturation) you can export with CDL Export for Resolve or Nuke.

The Viewer has its own exposure and gamma for checking; they do not change the output. Write saves a 16-bit TIFF.
